title: Truthful Communication and Exclusive Information Clubs
abstract: arXiv:2605.02776v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies how strategic communication shapes endogenous communication networks. Agents form costly links, observe noisy private signals about a common state, exchange cheap-talk messages with neighbors, and choose actions that reward accuracy and coordination. We show that full revelation is sustainable if and only if every connected component is a clique. We then characterize the core of the endogenous network-formation game with heterogeneous signal precisions and weakly convex linking costs. Although every network admits non-informative continuation equilibria, every core outcome is truthful and consists of assortative exclusive information clubs generated by a recursive precision-cost maximization procedure. The characterization follows from an individual payoff bound that holds uniformly over all continuation strategy profiles. translated_title: 真实沟通与排他性信息俱乐部
translated_abstract: 本文研究策略性沟通如何塑造内生沟通网络。个体形成有成本的链接，观察关于共同状态的含噪声私人信号，与邻居交换“空谈”信息，并选择兼顾准确性与协调性的行动。我们证明，完全信息披露是可持续的，当且仅当每个连通分量都是一个完全图。随后，我们刻画了在信号精度异质且链接成本弱凸条件下内生网络形成博弈的核。尽管任何网络都存在非信息性的后续均衡，但每一个核结果都是真实的，并且由一个递归的“精度-成本”最大化程序所生成的同类相聚的排他性信息俱乐部构成。这一刻画源于一个在所有后续策略组合上一致成立的个体收益上界。核稳定的俱乐部未必是有效率的：同类相聚的匹配可能导致高精度信号（的集中）……
tldr: 本文证明在策略性沟通网络中，完全披露当且仅当每个连通分量为完全图时才可持续，且网络形成博弈的核结果必然是真实的，并表现为由递归“精度-成本”最大化生成的同类排他性信息俱乐部，尽管这些俱乐部未必有效率。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that full revelation is sustainable if and only if every connected component is a clique, and that every core outcome of the endogenous network-formation game is truthful, consisting of assortative exclusive information clubs generated by a recursive precision-cost maximization procedure, though such clubs need not be efficient.
